newsitem.title: CANADA: TecSyn names Wayne Corbett CEO.
newsitem.headline: TecSyn names Wayne Corbett CEO.

text.p: TecSyn International Inc said on Tuesday that it appointed Wayne Corbett president and chief executive effective on September 1.
Corbett, who was also named to the board, will replace Zoltan Simo who will resign on August 31. Simo will remain in an advisory capacity until November to ensure a smooth transition, TecSyn said.

TecSyn cited Corbett's experience in engineering, manufacturing and product development in the automotive industry as reasons for the appointment. Corbett is currently president of TecSyn's TecSyn PMP Inc unit.
